title: IV drip stand with a slow drip
why: The medical room reads as a storage closet at 1x; a drip stand beside the cot says 'clinic' in one glance and adds a tiny idle motion.
acceptance: 1 px steel pole (gray3/gray5) on a 5 px tripod foot standing on the floor line y=46, right of the cot
bag 3x5 px cream2/cream3 with a 1 px red3 label, top-left rim lit by the room lamp (lamp1, max 2 px)
3 frames: one drip pixel moves down the 1 px tube 0 -> 2 -> 4 px, then loops; nothing else changes
only the listed palette names; ol0 outline on the bag and foot, none on the 1 px tube
still readable at 1x next to room_medical and does not cover the cot or the wall cross sign
notes: Example spec for docs/micro-assets.md. Room interiors are 64x52; the floor line is about y=46.
author: Claude (example)
